title: Bound real-launcher fixture fingerprint work and preserve its stderr diagnostics
outcome: Bound real-launcher fixture fingerprint work and preserve its stderr diagnostics
acceptance: The disposable real-launcher fixture avoids whole-repository deletion diffs during its readiness guards and keeps evidence private to the disposable repository.
The fixture drains/reports launcher stderr on failure and has an explicit maintained contract for the launcher helper files it copies, without inflated timeouts or blind retries.
